positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked alongside fellow engineers to develop and implement a streamlined solution for processing and analyzing qualitative CNE data, which included:
- Processing raw data with Apache Spark Libraries on a Hadoop cluster with Kubernetes for container orchestration
- Storing processed summary data on MongoDB with proper schema architecture for fast and efficient queries
- Presenting summary data on a comprehensive and intuitive dashboard using the plotly dash framework

• Had a great time (:
